tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sems bskyed pa'i cho ga mdo tsam du byas pa// rgyal ba sras bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge legs chu byung yon tan sbrang rtsis gtams/ /bde gshegs rkang drug ldan pa'i tshogs kyi rten/ /srid zhi'i rgud pas gzir ba rnams kyi rgyan/ /byang chub sems mchog ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan mchod/ /'dir 'gro ba 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru chen/ phun sum tshogs pa gnyis kyi 'byung gnas/ rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bgyid pa la/ sngon 'gro'i chos/ cho ga dngos/ mjug gi bslab bya gsum gyi dang po la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba bsam pa ni/ 'o skol rnams kyi mi lus thob pa 'di rnyed dka' ba yin zhing / de'ang mi rtag pa 'chi ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ da lta gson pa'i dus 'dir/ dge ba bsgrub pa la 'bad pa 'don 'tshal te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ dka' ba brgya yis rnyed pa mi/ /mi rnams thob pa'i khom pa dkon/ /bzlog pa med pa'i 'chi bdag ni/ /rtag tu mdun na gnas pa na/ /gang gis dul sbyin yang dag sdom/ /brgya tshags mang pos ma rdogs na/ /mi bzad 'khor ba'i mya ngam du/ /'gro ba 'di dag sdug bsngal thob/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ni/ de lta na'ang / shi ba'i 'og tu/ 'khor bar 'khor tshe bde'o snyam na/ 'khor ba la bde ba mnog pa dang ldan pa cung zad kyang med de/ rgyud bla mar/ mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /de dag sdug rtag med mtshon kha ba rgya tsha la sogs reg skyes bzhin/ /lha la 'chi 'pho mi la yongs tshol sdug bsngal zhes byar rtogs pa'i phyir/ /shes rab ldan pa lha mi'i dbang phyug dag la'ang mngon par 'dod med de/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i phan yon bsam pa ni/ sdug bsngal can 'khor ba las grol ba'i lam de/

bla na med pa thob byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bo byang chub kyi sems yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems kyi rta zhon nas/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems shes su zhig sgyid lug 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dngos la gnyis kyi/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma brgyud pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs par mos shing / bdag la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed de/ gsol ba gdab pa'i 'dun pas lad mo mdzod/ btsun pa skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyis byang chub kyi sems bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab tu gzhug gnyis pa gsol ba btab nas ji ltar sgrub pa la gsum gyi dang po cho ga la bdun gyi dang po mchod pa 'bul ba la drug gi phyag gi mchod pa ni/ rang gi lus dpag tu med par sprul nas/ sems can thams cad dang thabs gcig tu phyag 'tshal bar bsgoms la lad mo mdzod/ na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na moḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ na mo maṇ+ḍa de wa te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /'jig rten na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod rdzas ji snyed pa blos blangs nas 'bul bar mos pas lad mo mdzod/ gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ /yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun/ /blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ /yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /zhes brjod do/ /dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa ni/ mdun du bshams pa'i rdzas ni lha rdzas las grub pa nam mkha'i khams khyab par mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pratīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/

pa d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ badz+ra shap+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /lus 'bul ba'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi lus bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i 'bangs su 'bul snyam pa'i 'dun pas lad mo mdzod/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus 'di gtan du 'bul bar bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /zhes brjod do/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas/ mchod pa sna tshogs dang / sgrub pa'i mchod pas mchod par mos la/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /ces brjod do/ /bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi yon tan gyi bsngags pa dpag tu med par mos la/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan mgrin de dag la/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa skyabs 'gro ni/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs gnas zhu bsam pa'i 'dun pas lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung nas byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /gsum pa sdig pa bshag pa ni/ sangs rgyas thob don du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs bcol te sngar byas kyi sdig pa 'gyod pas bshags shing /

phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdom snyam pas lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu la sogs pa'i mthar/ bdag dang gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas/ las dang nyon mongs kyi dbang du gyur pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa thams cad so sor bshags shing / yang mi bgyid do/ /zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/ bdag gzhan gyi dge rtsa la rjes su yi rang bsams pas lad mo mdzod/ so so skye bo nas/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba chos 'khor mi bskor ba de dag la sems can smin grol bgyi ba'i slad du chos zhu bar bsgoms la lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu la sogs pa'i mthar/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi bzhed pa de dag thams cad la sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /zhes brjod do/ /drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin te/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag la bskal pa ji srid par mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab snyam pas lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu la sogs pa'i mthar/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs pa de dag la/ 'khor ba ji srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas sems can gyi don mdzad par gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod do/ /bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ mchod pa nas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa'i bar gyi dge ba dang /

gzhan yang dge rtsa thams cad gcig tu bsdoms te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod cig phyogs bcu na la sogs pa'i mthar/ bdag gis de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gi mthus bdag gi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang / mthar phyin par gyur cig ces brjod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis kyi bsam pa sbyor ba ni/ spyod 'jug las/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang / /sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /'phangs pa med par gtang bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag gi lus/ longs spyod/ dge ba thams cad/ sems can kun la byin pas/ sems can re res kyang yongs su rdzogs pa thob nas/ sdig pa dang / sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral/ dge ba dang / bde ba phun sum tshogs pa de myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur par bsam mo/ /de las bdag sems bskyed nas/ bslab bya la slob pa ltar/ sems can thams cad kyang de ltar 'gyur bar bsgom pa lags/ gnyis pa yid dam bca' ba ni/ bsam pa de lta bu dang / sems bskyed blang ba'i yul dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa ni/ ring por mi thogs par byang chub kyi sems bla na med pa skye bar 'gyur ro snyam pas bdag gi lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu la sogs pa'i mthar/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas de dag gis/ sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed pa ji bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang /

byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum zlos su gzhug go /gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la gnyis kyi/ rang dga' ba sgom pa ni/ bdag byang chub sems dpar gyur pa de shin tu drin che/ da rigs dang mthun pa'i spyod pa la ci nas kyang bslab dgos snyam du mos pas lad mo mdzod/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes brjod do/ /gzhan dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ bdag gis sems bskyed nas/ skye dgu thams cad kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don bsgrub par bya yi/ lha la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad dga' bar mdzod cig ces soms la rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gis de ring spyod pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la 'gron du bos zin gyi/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar bgyi/ /zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa mjug gi bslab bya brjod pa ni/ spang bya nag po'i chos bzhi spong ba dang / bsgrub bya dkar po'i chos bzhi sgrub pa la slob pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bla ma dang / mchod pa'i slu ba gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa/ sems bskyed pa'i byang sems la mi snyan pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa/ sems can la g.yo sgyus spyod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ srog gi phyir yang bsams bzhin brdzun mi smra/ sems la lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gnas par bya ba'i g.yo sgyus ma yin pa/ sems bskyed pa'i byang sems la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing yon tan phyogs bcur sgrog pa/

sems can dge ba la 'god pa de dag kyang bla med kyi byang chub la 'god kyi nyan rang ma yin pa'o/ /tha na nyin lan gsum mtshan gsum du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas sems bskyed pa'i cho ga legs par grub cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de chud mi za zhing mthar phyin par bgyi ba'i slad du bsngo ba bgyi bas/ rang gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsam pa rnam par dag pas bsdus nas/ sems can thams cad dang thun mong du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo snyam du bsgoms la/ phyogs bcu la sogs pa'i mthar/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /rgas nad 'chi ba'i rba rlabs srid 'khrugs pa'i/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /ces pa dang / sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /rtsi dang nags kyi shing lta bu/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyi/ /'dod dgu dpag med spyod par shog /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /thos pa dang ni dran pas kyang / /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams gso bar byed gyur cig /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag su bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /ces lan gsum gyi rjes su/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gis bsngos shing smon lam du btab pa de kho na bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga mdo tsam du byas pa/ btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ lcags mo sbrul gyi lo/ nag pa'i zla ba'i gnam gang la yi ge rigs su bkod pa'o//
